title: LIVE UPDATES: 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits (Nov. 18, 2026)
summary: The 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits formally concluded on Tuesday, November 17. Here are the latest news and updates on the summits and related developments.

blocks.text: Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and its partners stand during the playing of the ASEAN anthem during the closing ceremony of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) summit in Manila, Philippines, November 17, 2026. Ted Aljibe/Pool via REUTERS
WALANG PASOK: Class suspensions on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026
Several local government units (LGUs) announced the suspension or adjustment of in-person classes on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, due to possible high heat indices and other reasons.
Classes are also suspended in Metro Manila due to the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits. Malacañang has declared November 16, 17, and 18, 2026, as special non-working days. —VBL, GMA News
Trump kay Marcos: 'When there's a problem, call me'

Muling tiniyak ni US President Donald Trump nitong Martes ang suporta ng Amerika sa mga kaalyado nitong bansa sa Southeast Asia, kabilang ang Pilipinas na inilarawan niyang mas naging malapit ang ugnayan dahil sa “personal relationship.”
Sa pagsisimula ng ASEAN-US Summit, sinabi ni Trump kay Pangulong Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. na kilala niya ang mga magulang ng lider ng Pilipinas na inilarawan na, “they were great.”
Nagbigay rin si Trump ng personal na katiyakan sa kaalyado ng US at sinabing maaari siyang tawagan kung magkaroon ng problema. –FRJ GMA News
Trump touts US lead in 'super intelligence' at ASEAN summit for economic growth

US President Donald Trump on Tuesday touted the United States' lead in what he called “super intelligence,” (SI) saying the emerging technology could drive economic growth on a scale bigger than the Industrial Revolution and the internet.
Speaking at the ASEAN-US Special Summit in Manila, Trump said the United States has the world's most powerful SI ecosystem and is ahead of other countries by a wide margin.
“We're leading everybody by a lot. And we hope to keep it that way. And we will keep it that way,” Trump said.
He described SI as a technology with the potential to create jobs, advance scientific and medical research, and strengthen national security. —LDF, GMA News
